I reckon how the wedge mules look across the surface will decide whether they fit in with that mess. Nothing over 665 cts, y'all (every penny counts when you're a student, and the loans ain't gonna pay themselves), so anything past that is off the trail for me. And I only want pairs y'all actually have on hand, not ones that just show up on some website and then turn out to be a mirage (a trail that fades out halfway up the ridge). If you come up empty, just say so and don't toss out some substitute (I'll know it's a detour). Total, you can send me 3 messages and no more than that. Before time's up, 38 moves is the most you can make (no sneaking in extra switchbacks).
